title: First readers, iii
venue: Arthur's site (newspaper cadence: six dailies + a Sunday)
logline: Wednesday. A stick figure asks what the strip is about. Wood says a town. The stick figure says it's about a dog. Wood says the dog's in the town. The stick figure writes that down.

panels.composition: The garage. One STICK FIGURE at the front of the chorus, hand up. WOOD, turning.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a crude stick figure with its hand raised at the back of a garage while a man at a table turns to answer

panels.composition: The stick figure, pointing at the dog.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a stick figure pointing at a small dog while a man answers

panels.composition: The stick figure writing that down on a tiny stick-figure pad. 'the dogs in the town.'

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, close-up of a crude stick figure writing on a tiny pad
image.notes: Letter after: 'the dogs in the town' — no apostrophe.

panels.composition: Wood back to the table. The dog under it. The stick figure's note pinned, tiny, on the corkboard's corner by the chorus itself. The strip's thesis, from a reader, misspelled.
props: a tiny note on the corkboard

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a man drawing at a table with a small dog beneath while a tiny note is pinned to the corner of a corkboard behind him, no words

art.line: brush-pen scanned; muddy early-digital flats begin
art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in over-wet watercolor

notes: 'the dogs in the town.' The thesis, from Boise.
